facts.text: Under Penn State's 2 + 2 plan, students can complete their first two years at Penn State Scranton and transition to University Park or another campus for their remaining two years.

sources.title: 2 + 2 Degree Plan | Penn State Scranton
sources.quote: Some students choose to remain at one campus for all four years, while other students spend their first two years at one campus and transition to University Park or another campus for their remaining two years.
